newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - June 30.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Hong Kong sovereignty reverts to China at midnight; Chinese leaders Jiang Zemin, Li Peng arrive in Hong Kong in the afternoon, Chinese troops enter Hong Kong at night.
--Telephone, garbage collection rates, labour insurance premiums to increase on July 1
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Straits Exchange Foundation chairman Koo Chen-fu, arriving in Hong Kong for handover ceremony, calls for more harmonious relations between Taiwan and Hong Kong
--Mainland Chinese President Jiang Zemin reiterates that autonomy can be exercised in Hong Kong
LIBERTY TIMES - Ceremony of the century to kick off in Hong Kong at midnight as Britain hands Hong Kong back to China
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Hong Kong re-export role in Taiwan-China trade rapidly downgraded as more trade is routed through Japan or South Korea
--Transport and Telecommunications Ministry plans to open satellite communication business to private sector in July 1998
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government to restrict Taiwan-Hong Kong trade if conditions not favourable to Taiwan
--China assures Hong Kong people it will not intervene in financial markets
